rules.source: Organic Act No. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004 on the Protection of Personal Data (Tunisia) — https://www.dlapiperdataprotection.com/?t=law&c=TN
rules.retrieved_snippet: DLA Piper (search summary): Article 1 affirms every individual's right to protection of personal data relating to private life, as a fundamental right guaranteed by the Constitution; INPDP is the supervisory authority; a replacement law has been under review since 2017. Aggregator claims of breach notification/DPO duties conflict with DLA Piper and are not recorded.
